questions.question: In the ninth year of King Hoshea of Israel, what happened to the city of Samaria?

answers.text: The king of Assyria captured it

questions.question: What did the king of Assyria do to Israel's King Hoshea after discovering Hoshea's plot with Egypt?

answers.text: Arrested him and put him in prison
Made him pay double the next year
Sent him away to live in Egypt

questions.question: Before Israel was exiled, what did the LORD tell Israel and Judah through His prophets and seers to do?

answers.text: Turn back and keep His commandments
Make peace with the king of Assyria
Build up Samaria's walls for war

questions.question: After Israel was torn away from the house of David, what did their new king Jeroboam do to the people?

answers.text: Led them away from following the LORD
Led them back to the house of David
Led them out of the land to Egypt
